verdict.rationale: RealtimeKit documents managed server-side recording, including composite video or separate participant audio tracks, and it sends signed recording events to your backend. Nothing in the evidence says the recording files are delivered to a customer-owned storage bucket. The WebSocket media adapter is only a building block and earns no credit here. missing for 10: documented delivery of recordings to the developer's own storage bucket (e.g. S3/R2 configuration), details on recording output formats, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can record a session server-side and receive the files in my own storage bucket

citations.quote: Add managed recording or transcription if your app needs it.
Capture composite video or separate participant audio tracks.
Receive signed meeting, participant, and recording events in your backend.
